LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.titleTraditional: 說一段已經發生的時間
LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.titleEnglish: Say How Long Something Took with One 了
LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.learnerPromise: Say how long something lasted when the story is finished.
LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: This sentence tells how long an action lasted. The action is already finished. A time word like 昨天 (yesterday) or 去年 (last year) shows that the story is closed.

lessonWorld.title: Two New Years on one timeline
lessonWorld.prompt: The teacher remembers standing outside for one whole night last year.
lessonWorld.traditional: 去年我在那裡站了一晚。
lessonWorld.simplified: 去年我在那里站了一晚。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Qùnián wǒ zài nàlǐ zhàn le yì wǎn.
lessonWorld.english: Last year I stood there for the whole night.

items.question: Where does 了 go when I say how long something lasted?
items.answer: Right after the action word. A 了 at the very end changes the meaning to 'still going on now'.

words.meaning: ending word: something is done or has changed

items.question: My story is finished. Do I add a final 了 too?
items.answer: No. A finished time word like 去年 already closes the story. Use just one 了, right after the action.

right.english: Last year I lived for half a year.

items.question: Do I still need 了 if the time word already shows it is past?
items.answer: Yes. The time word shows WHEN; the 了 after the action shows the action is done.

right.pinyin: Zuótiān shuì le bā ge xiǎoshí.
right.english: He slept for eight hours yesterday.

words.meaning: ending word: something is done or has changed

timelineLab.title: Does the line end before NOW?
timelineLab.description: A finished story ends before now. The time word tells how long the action lasted.

choices.label: Last year
choices.traditional: 去年我在日本住了半年。
choices.simplified: 去年我在日本住了半年。
choices.pinyin: Qùnián wǒ zài Rìběn zhù le bànnián.
choices.english: Last year I lived in Japan for half a year.
choices.note: 去年 shows that the whole stay is inside a finished time.

choices.label: Yesterday
choices.traditional: 我昨天晚上看了兩個小時的書。
choices.simplified: 我昨天晚上看了两个小时的书。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang kàn le liǎng ge xiǎoshí de shū.
choices.english: I studied for two hours last night.
choices.note: The study time is inside yesterday.

choices.label: Weekend
choices.traditional: 我們上週末打了兩個小時的籃球。
choices.simplified: 我们上周末打了两个小时的篮球。
choices.pinyin: Wǒmen shàng zhōumò dǎ le liǎng ge xiǎoshí de lánqiú.
choices.english: We played basketball for two hours last weekend.
choices.note: The finished weekend closes the story.

timelineLab.takeaway: This page says how long something lasted in a finished story. Context—not just the count of 了—closes the timeline.

examples.teachingNote: Duration expression with single 了 indicates a completed action in the past.

text.traditional: 去年我在日本住了半年。
text.simplified: 去年我在日本住了半年。
text.pinyin: Qùnián wǒ zài Rìběn zhù le bànnián.
text.english: Last year I lived in Japan for half a year.

examples.teachingNote: In dialogues, single 了 confirms the completed duration explaining current fatigue.

text.traditional: A: 你們為什麼都很累？ B: 因為我們昨天都工作了十個小時，所以今天都很累。
text.simplified: A: 你们为什么都很累？ B: 因为我们昨天都工作了十个小时，所以今天都很累。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐmen wèishénme dōu hěn lèi? B: Yīnwèi wǒmen zuótiān dōu gōngzuò le shí ge xiǎoshí, suǒyǐ jīntiān dōu hěn lèi.
text.english: A: Why are you all so tired? B: Because we all worked for ten hours yesterday, so today we are all very tired.

examples.teachingNote: 玩了十多天 indicates completed duration of vacation.

text.traditional: A: 我聽說上個月你去美國了。 B: 是啊，我在美國玩了十多天，上個週末回來的。
text.simplified: A: 我听说上个月你去美国了。 B: 是啊，我在美国玩了十多天，上个周末回来的。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ tīngshuō shàng ge yuè nǐ qù Měiguó le. B: Shì a, wǒ zài Měiguó wán le shí duō tiān, shàng ge zhōumò huílái de.
text.english: A: I heard you went to the US last month. B: Yes, I had fun in the US for more than ten days, and came back last weekend.

LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.titleTraditional: 把兩個選擇放在比的兩邊
LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Say which person, thing, or experience has more of a quality.
LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: Put the thing you are describing before 比. Put the thing you compare it with after 比. End with the describing word or the difference.

lessonWorld.title: Compare ways to celebrate
lessonWorld.prompt: Youmei prefers celebrating with friends to watching television at home.
lessonWorld.traditional: 跟朋友跨年比在家看電視有趣。
lessonWorld.simplified: 跟朋友跨年比在家看电视有趣。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu kuànián bǐ zài jiā kàn diànshì yǒuqù.
lessonWorld.english: Celebrating with friends is more interesting than watching TV at home.

LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.pattern: A + 比 + B + quality or difference

patternRows.english: Flying is faster than taking a train.
This year is much more interesting than before.

items.question: Can I say 今天比昨天很冷?
items.answer: No. 比 already compares. Use 多了 at the end to show a big difference.

right.pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng duō le.
right.english: Today is much colder than yesterday.

items.question: Which thing goes first?
items.answer: The one you are describing. Put 比 after it, then the other thing.

items.question: Where does the describing word go?
items.answer: At the end, after 比 and the other thing.

right.pinyin: Zuò fēijī bǐ zuò huǒchē kuài.
right.english: Flying is faster than taking a train.

pairCompareLab.title: Keep both sides visible
pairCompareLab.description: A is the thing you describe. B is the thing after 比 that you compare with. Reverse them and the meaning reverses.

choices.label: Weather
choices.note: 今天 is the one described. 昨天 is what it is compared with.

choices.label: Travel speed
choices.traditional: 坐飛機比坐火車快多了。
choices.simplified: 坐飞机比坐火车快多了。
choices.pinyin: Zuò fēijī bǐ zuò huǒchē kuài duō le.
choices.english: Flying is much faster than taking a train.
choices.note: 多了 shows a large difference.

choices.label: New Year
choices.traditional: 跟朋友跨年比在家看電視有趣。
choices.simplified: 跟朋友跨年比在家看电视有趣。
choices.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu kuànián bǐ zài jiā kàn diànshì yǒuqù.
choices.english: Celebrating with friends is more interesting than watching TV at home.
choices.note: Two whole activities can go on the two sides of 比.

pairCompareLab.takeaway: Read left to right: A, compared with B, has more of this quality.

ruleContrast.title: Do not add 很 to the comparison
ruleContrast.description: 比 already makes the comparison. Add 一點 or 多了 to show how big the difference is.

examples.label: 很 inside 比
examples.explanation: 很 describes a quality. It does not measure the difference after 比.

examples.label: Large difference
examples.explanation: 多了 shows a large difference.

examples.teachingNote: Basic A 比 B + quality.

text.traditional: 今天比昨天冷。
text.simplified: 今天比昨天冷。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng.
text.english: Today is colder than yesterday.

examples.teachingNote: 一點 marks a small difference.

text.traditional: 這件衣服比那件衣服長一點兒。
text.simplified: 这件衣服比那件衣服长一点儿。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu bǐ nà jiàn yīfu cháng yìdiǎnr.
text.english: This item of clothing is a little longer than that one.

examples.teachingNote: 多了 marks a large difference.

text.traditional: 坐飛機比坐火車快多了。
text.simplified: 坐飞机比坐火车快多了。
text.pinyin: Zuò fēijī bǐ zuò huǒchē kuài duō le.
text.english: Flying is much faster than taking a train.

examples.teachingNote: An exact difference follows the quality.

text.traditional: 我弟弟比我高五公分。
text.simplified: 我弟弟比我高五公分。
text.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi bǐ wǒ gāo wǔ gōngfēn.
text.english: My younger brother is five centimeters taller than me.

LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.titleTraditional: 讓時間線一路走到現在
LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.titleEnglish: Say a Situation Reaches NOW with Two 了
LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Say that something began earlier and is still going on now.
LESSON_FOURTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: The first 了 follows the action. The final 了 shows that the time reaches now.

lessonWorld.title: Two New Years on one timeline
lessonWorld.prompt: The group began waiting earlier and is still waiting now.
lessonWorld.traditional: 我們已經等了三十分鐘了。
lessonWorld.simplified: 我们已经等了三十分钟了。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng děng le sānshí fēnzhōng le.
lessonWorld.english: We have been waiting for thirty minutes.

timelineLab.title: Does the line touch NOW?
timelineLab.description: When the action reaches now, the final 了 shows that it is still going on.

choices.label: Still in Taiwan
choices.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān zhù le bànnián le.
choices.english: I have lived in Taiwan for half a year.
choices.note: The stay reaches NOW and still holds.

choices.label: Still sleeping
choices.traditional: 他已經睡了八個小時了，現在還在睡。
choices.simplified: 他已经睡了八个小时了，现在还在睡。
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng shuì le bā ge xiǎoshí le, xiànzài hái zài shuì.
choices.english: He has slept for eight hours and is still sleeping.
choices.note: 現在還在睡 shows that the action is still going on.

choices.label: Still playing
choices.traditional: 我們已經踢了一個小時的足球了。
choices.simplified: 我们已经踢了一个小时的足球了。
choices.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng tī le yí ge xiǎoshí de zúqiú le.
choices.english: We have been playing soccer for an hour.
choices.note: The time reaches now, so the speakers may decide to rest.

timelineLab.takeaway: If the action reaches now, the final 了 makes that clear.

ruleContrast.title: Choose by context, not by counting 了
ruleContrast.description: The one-了 sentence is not wrong by itself. The two-了 form directly shows that the action is still going on.

examples.label: Reports a period
examples.explanation: This tells about a six-month stay. The rest of the story decides whether it continues.

examples.label: Reaches now
examples.explanation: The final 了 directly shows that the stay reaches now.

examples.label: Marker before the duration
examples.explanation: Do not put both 了 before the time word.

examples.teachingNote: The rest reaches now.

text.simplified: 我休息了十分钟了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiūxi le shí fēnzhōng le.
text.english: I have been resting for ten minutes.

items.question: How do I say it is still going on NOW?
items.answer: Add a second 了 at the very end. Keep the first 了 right after the action word.

timelineLab.title: Does the line touch NOW?

items.question: Can I say 今天比昨天很冷?
items.answer: No. 比 already compares. Use 多了 at the end to show a big difference.

items.question: Which thing goes first?
items.answer: The one you are describing. Put 比 after it, then the other thing.

items.question: Where does the describing word go?
items.answer: At the end, after 比 and the other thing.

pairCompareLab.title: Keep both sides visible

text.pinyin: Zài Rìběn, kuànián de shíhou, hěn duō rén zài jiā gēn jiārén yìqǐ kàn diànshì. Dànshì wǒ xǐhuan hé péngyǒu yìqǐ kuànián, bǐ zài jiā kàn diànshì yǒuqù.
text.english: In Japan, many people stay at home and watch TV with their families on New Year’s Eve. But I like to celebrate New Year’s Eve with friends. It’s more fun than watching TV at home.

words.meaning: link word that connects a describing word to a thing

text.traditional: 我也喜歡跟朋友一起跨年，而且今年比以前有意思多了，因為在台灣跟你們一起玩，覺得很特別。
text.simplified: 我也喜欢跟朋友一起跨年，而且今年比以前有意思多了，因为在台湾跟你们一起玩，觉得很特别。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuan gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ kuànián, érqiě jīnnián bǐ yǐqián yǒuyìsi duō le, yīnwèi zài Táiwān gēn nǐmen yìqǐ wán, juéde hěn tèbié.
text.english: I also like to celebrate it with friends. And this year is much more interesting than before, because I am here in Taiwan and get to spend time with you. I think it is a special experience.

text.traditional: 我同意，我也覺得今年很有意思。
text.simplified: 我同意，我也觉得今年很有意思。
text.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì, wǒ yě juéde jīnnián hěn yǒuyìsi.
text.english: I agree. I also think this year is very interesting.
